$description: HARDSET design tokens v2.0 (modular report, black and white with one muted green accent). Single source for tokens.css and the logo files. Owner choices 2026-11-13: portrait B5, Eukaliptus accent, logo v4.

ink.role: text, dark surfaces, page background in the dark edition

paper.role: page background in the light edition, text on ink

steel.role: chart base, secondary fills on paper

line.role: hairlines and table rows on paper

tint.role: highlighted rows, formula boxes on paper

accent.role: Eukaliptus: fills and large elements on ink (4.58:1) and on paper (3.72:1). Not for small text.

accent-text.role: accent as small text on paper (5.35:1) and on tint (4.71:1)

accent-on-panel.role: accent as small text on ink panels (4.66:1)

panel.role: side panel and raised surface in the dark edition

panel-line.role: panel rules, chart base on ink

type-scale-pt.$description: Print/PDF scale for B5 pages. Running text 9.3/13.6 pt.
